title: Crestline Fleet Account Weekend Mobile Visit Surcharge
content:
A contested mobile service visit fee on a Crestline Fleet Account carries a weekend surcharge, added to the fee the visit owes.

| Day of the week of the visit | Weekend surcharge |
|---|---|
| Sunday | 12.00 |
| Saturday | 8.00 |
| Monday through Friday | nothing |

The visit's day is the invoice date of the visit fee invoice, read as a calendar day of the week.

## Illustration (hypothetical fee owed of 26.00 before the surcharge)

- Visit on a Saturday: 26.00 plus 8.00, that is 34.00 before any credit.
- Visit on a Sunday: 26.00 plus 12.00, that is 38.00 before any credit.
- Visit on a Wednesday: 26.00, with no surcharge.

The fee owed is never below 0.00, the floor being applied once after every addition and credit, not to each amount in turn.
